registry.surfaceRule: For each team-season, derive governed home-surface class from the modal non-neutral surface of that club's scheduled home games in the same season. This is schedule/venue metadata only and may use the full season because no outcome or market field is involved.

surfaceClasses.SYNTHETIC: every non-empty surface value not classified NATURAL

registry.neutralVenueRule: Neutral/international travel, body-clock and altitude features are excluded unless an explicit versioned neutral-venue registry resolves the venue. Other independently resolvable families remain eligible.

h4Control.rule: S2 estimates only residual schedule effects after the governed H4 base location term; it never changes H4.

teamStrengthControl.rule: Before each target week, fit market-free team point strengths from completed prior regular-season score margins after removing the H4 base location term. Use the two most recent eligible prior seasons plus completed current-season games. Ratings are sealed before the target week's outcomes and centered to zero.

pregameStrengthTiersForBookByeRows.rule: Tiers reproduce the printed bye-row shape for diagnostic BOOK-EXACT/scalar models only. Current family fitting also receives continuous sealed pregame strength interactions and is not required to preserve these categorical magnitudes.

featureRules.TURF_SURFACE: Compare away team's governed season home-surface class with the current governed home venue surface; same = signed -1 book S unit to home, opposite = +1. Neutral/unresolved surface cases fail closed for this family.
featureRules.DIVISION_CONFERENCE: Same division = signed -1 book S unit to home. Different conference = signed +1. Same-conference non-division = zero reference.
featureRules.REST_PRIMETIME: Use weekday, scheduled kickoff and immediately prior game weekday/venue. Current-game home Thursday night=+2, Sunday night=+4, Monday night=+2 book units. Prior-Monday rows use the printed home/away previous-venue magnitudes with sign expressed as home-benefit units. Zero printed rows remain zero. Also derive clipped home-minus-away rest-days as a current-calibration extension with zero prior.
featureRules.ROAD_DENSITY: Current visitor fires +2 home-benefit book units only when the current game is its third designated away game among its trailing four scheduled games including current.
featureRules.OVERTIME_RECOVERY: If home team immediately follows an overtime game, prior-home OT=-4 home-benefit units and prior-away OT=-2. If away team follows OT, signs reverse to +4/+2.
featureRules.BYE: Rest >=12 days defines off-bye. Apply the printed tier magnitude to the team, using sealed pregame rating percentile; away rows use the printed away magnitude and negative home-benefit sign. Also derive continuous sealed strength x bye interaction with zero prior for partial-pool testing.
featureRules.SUPER_BOWL_AFTEREFFECT: Use prior-season Super Bowl winner/loser identity. First game uses the printed first-game magnitude instead of also stacking the first-four row; games 2-4 use first-four magnitude. Team benefit is signed toward that team; loser effect is signed toward its opponent.
featureRules.TRAVEL_DISTANCE: For non-neutral games, compute great-circle miles from away team's governed home base to current home team's governed home base. 2000+ miles fires the printed +1 home book unit. Partial-pool extensions use prelocked 750-1249, 1250-1999 and 2000+ bins plus continuous thousands-of-miles, all with zero prior. Named regional rows are never encoded.
featureRules.TIME_ZONE_BODY_CLOCK: For non-neutral games, compare away team home/body-clock zone with home venue zone. BOOK-EXACT diagnostic rows use 13:00 ET-equivalent early games for PACIFIC/MOUNTAIN visitors and night kickoff for EASTERN/CENTRAL/MOUNTAIN visitors. Partial-pool extensions use signed zone displacement and kickoff bucket rather than named team exceptions.
featureRules.CONSECUTIVE_REMOTE: Visitor fires +2 home book units only when current and immediately prior scheduled games are both at least two nominal time-zone bands from its home zone and the prior game was also away from home.
featureRules.BOUNCE_BACK: Previous same-season loss 19-28 produces team benefit 2 book units; 29+ produces 4 book units, never both. Apply signed toward home/away team as appropriate.
featureRules.ALTITUDE_EXPOSURE: Extension only. A non-neutral visitor to a HIGH registry home environment creates a +1 raw altitude indicator with coefficient prior zero. It is never included in BOOK-EXACT/scalar S units.
featureRules.MATCHUP_VARIABLE: Excluded and always zero; personnel and matchup production own it.

S_BOOK_EXACT_020.description: Supported printed rows at exactly 0.20 point per signed S unit; BW-A006 named regional rows blocked.

S_CURRENT_SCALAR.description: One current points-per-book-S-unit coefficient estimated on 2021-24 only.

S_PARTIAL_POOL_FAMILY.description: Factor-level coefficients shrink toward the current scalar for printed features and zero for extensions; family summaries are sample-weighted diagnostics.

evaluation.target: observed home margin minus sealed pregame team-strength differential minus governed H4 base location points
evaluation.modelAcceptance: A calibrated model is aggregate-accepted only if held-out 2025 MAE and RMSE both equal or improve S_ZERO_BASELINE and absolute mean error does not exceed S_ZERO_BASELINE by more than 0.05 point.
evaluation.selection: Prefer S_CURRENT_SCALAR when aggregate-accepted. S_PARTIAL_POOL_FAMILY may outrank it only if it equals or improves the scalar on both held-out MAE and RMSE and its absolute mean error is no more than 0.05 point worse.
evaluation.familyRule: A family becomes an S3 numeric candidate only when deterministic, non-conflicted, sufficiently sampled, coefficient direction is not materially reversed in validation, and its affected-game held-out MAE is no more than 0.02 worse than zero on those same games. Rare-event backfill can stabilize diagnostics but cannot by itself satisfy current-regime production support.
evaluation.coefficientSafety: Any fitted single printed-factor coefficient with absolute effect greater than 1.00 point per S unit is automatically shadow-only pending audit; any extension coefficient implying greater than 1.50 points for a normal single-game trigger is shadow-only.
